name: Grove of the Ancients
summary: Nature spirits and kaldorei gather in the Grove of the Ancients, where Onu, an Ancient of Lore, keeps watch. Old temple ruins stand beside the Wildbend River in southeastern Darkshore.

sections.title: Sanctuary of the Wildbend
sections.body: Old temple stones ring the Grove of the Ancients in southeastern Darkshore. The Wildbend River runs through its heart, offering refuge from a troubled coastline. Nature spirits and kaldorei gather here as the Circle of Ancients. Together, they tend to the forest’s balance.

sections.title: Keepers and Watchers
sections.body: Onu, an Ancient of Lore, watches the land’s changing fortunes and offers wisdom to travelers. Wandering merchants and slumbering druids rest beneath the boughs. To the southeast, territorial furbolg camps hold their ground. Alliance sentinels and druids watch the southern reaches of Darkshore from this frontier outpost.

faq.q: Where is the Grove of the Ancients?
aliases: where is grove of the ancients
faq.answer: The Grove of the Ancients lies in southeastern Darkshore, against the mountain foothills near the Wildbend River.
Onu is an Ancient of Lore who lives in the grove. He watches over the southeastern woods and advises druids and travelers working to mend Darkshore’s balance.

faq.q: What is the Circle of Ancients?
faq.answer: The Circle of Ancients is an assembly of great nature spirits and ancient treants who gather at the grove to commune, share knowledge, and discuss the welfare of the wild lands.

faq.q: Are there dangers near the grove?
faq.answer: Hostile wildlife and territorial furbolg camps lie across the river and to the southeast of the grove.

angles.text: As a druid, you can seek wisdom from Onu, the Ancient of Lore, and the spirits of the forest at this revered sanctuary.
Ancient temple ruins and nature spirits surround the grove, a solemn reminder of the kaldorei’s long harmony with the land.
